title: Integrate and validate review-event behavior
description:
## Why
Correct isolated algorithms can still produce confusing combined browser behavior or performance and layout regressions.

## What
Run deterministic and real-data journeys, accessibility, layout, performance, documentation, source-integrity checks, and user review.
design: Keep correctness gates synthetic and real MOT20 observations read-only.
acceptance_criteria: All gates pass, source manifests are equal, browser evidence is recorded, and the user accepts event meaning and navigation.

title: Specify revisioned correction state
description:
## Why
Persistence and editing cannot be implemented safely until effective state, identity, revision, recovery, and geometry contracts are authoritative.

## What
Define the immutable-source plus correction-ledger model, SQLite behavior, stable identities, revision hashes, lifecycle states, conflicts, source switching, and existing-box geometry semantics.
design: Produce a focused design contract before implementation; events on edited drafts remain explicitly unresolved.
acceptance_criteria: The reviewed contract resolves replay, revisions, stale reads/writes, undo branches, recovery, raw/display geometry, export provenance, and open future-operation boundaries.

title: Implement approved review-event corrections
description:
## Why
Approved event semantics must be reflected precisely in detector and navigation behavior.

## What
Implement only corrections authorized by the semantics task while preserving raw measurements and event-only refresh isolation.
design: Use test-driven development per event family and verify combined settings without broad UI refactoring.
acceptance_criteria: Unit and browser tests prove all approved semantics, family combinations, stale-request behavior, disabled states, and exact navigation targets.

title: Characterize raw review-event algorithms
description:
## Why
Product corrections cannot be selected until the exact displacement, scale, and proximity mathematics and edge behavior are proven.

## What
Add characterization for normalization, gaps, zero-size boxes, missing observations, competitors, threshold operators, and equality boundaries without changing production behavior.
design: Use backend and frontend public contracts with minimal synthetic fixtures; production event behavior remains unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Characterization tests document every raw detector input, calculation, boundary, and diagnostic behavior and pass without production changes.

title: Define product-level review-event semantics
description:
## Why
Raw mathematical matches do not by themselves define useful reviewer activities, anchors, thresholds, or navigation.

## What
Use deterministic corruptions and read-only real observations to define user-facing meaning, grouping, anchors, threshold language, and previous/next behavior.
design: Produce an approved requirements decision before changing detector or navigation behavior.
acceptance_criteria: A reviewed document defines each event family, activity grouping, anchor rules, navigation behavior, threshold units/defaults, diagnostics, and non-goals.

title: Validate Track-Viz review-event semantics
description:
## Why
Abrupt displacement, scale change, and close interaction are not yet trusted as correct user-facing review tools.

## What
Characterize raw algorithms, approve product semantics, implement only justified corrections, and validate navigation and thresholds with synthetic and read-only real evidence.
design: Follow Epic 2 of the attached plan; preserve raw auditable measurements and isolate event refreshes from image and track loading.
acceptance_criteria: All children close with approved semantics, deterministic coverage, real-data observations, documentation, accessibility, performance, source integrity, and user acceptance.

title: Validate the visual and control foundation
description:
## Why
The new surface hierarchy and compact controls must be accepted before annotation UI starts depending on them.

## What
Run the full deterministic and real-data integration matrix, capture desktop/narrow evidence, compare performance, verify source integrity, and obtain user visual acceptance.
design: Implement Epic 1 Task 3 after both implementation children; keep real data observational and synthetic fixtures deterministic.
acceptance_criteria: make acceptance and make e2e-real pass as applicable; screenshots cover major modes; axe has zero serious/critical findings; performance is compared; source manifests are equal; user acceptance is recorded.
notes: Automated validation completed 2026-09-04: make acceptance passed (67 backend tests + 68 frontend tests, Ruff, mypy, TypeScript, production build, 45 deterministic Playwright passes with 13 intentional skips, local-data smoke, pip check). make e2e-real passed 7 with 1 intentional narrow performance skip. Pointer p50/p95 unchanged at 16.6/16.8 ms; cold seek 26.0/35.6 ms; warm seek 14.1/14.4 ms. Source manifests are byte-identical for 2,249 files. Axe found zero serious/critical violations. Fresh desktop/narrow Focus and Context screenshots are in track-viz/artifacts/verification/visual-control-foundation/. Awaiting user visual acceptance before closing.

title: Simplify Focus controls and visible provenance
description:
## Why
The current Focus/Context, context-count, trajectory, and policy-banner controls are larger and more confusing than the accepted product behavior requires.

## What
Use one Number of nearby tracks control with zero meaning Focus, add a compact Show future trajectory control, and remove the visible test-adapted banner while retaining provenance contracts.
design: Implement Epic 1 Task 2 test-first using the dark-theme tokens; preserve backend provenance and source safety.
acceptance_criteria: Focused tests and browser journeys prove exact zero/positive/capped context behavior, past-only default, distinct future trajectory, hidden UI banner, retained provenance, and no accessibility or layout regressions.
close_reason: Implemented the single Number of nearby tracks control (0 = Focus, positive = bounded Context), compact Show future trajectory checkbox, and removed the visible test-adapted banner while preserving source metadata/provenance. Verified 68 Vitest tests, production build/typecheck, and Playwright 45 passed with 13 intentional real-data skips across desktop and narrow projects.

title: Establish the dark visual foundation
description:
## Why
The current ruled-paper, light visual system is visually noisy and is not an appropriate foundation for a dense tracker-correction workspace.

## What
Replace and expand the existing theme tokens and restyle colors, backgrounds, borders, and restrained effects only. Preserve spacing, font metrics, grid/order, viewport geometry, behavior, and canvas rendering.
design: Implement Epic 1 Task 1 test-first; no layout or control-behavior changes.
acceptance_criteria: Desktop and narrow visual-contract tests prove dark semantic surfaces, no ruled background, measurable contrast, no overflow, minimum viewport area, unchanged image/overlay alignment, and passing axe; frontend tests, typecheck, E2E, build, and screenshots pass.
close_reason: Implemented the approved color/surface-only dark foundation. Test-first visual contract failed on the prior light scheme, then passed in desktop and narrow Chromium. Fresh verification: TypeScript passed; 18 frontend files / 68 tests passed; production build passed; deterministic Playwright passed 45 with 13 intentional real-data skips, including axe, layout stability, canvas alignment, and the new contrast/no-overflow/minimum-viewport contract. Screenshots saved under track-viz/artifacts/verification/dark-visual/.

title: Modernize Track-Viz visual and control foundation
description:
## Why
The ruled-paper visual language and dense control presentation will not scale to future annotation workflows.

## What
Deliver the approved dark visual foundation, simplify Focus controls, and validate accessibility, responsiveness, source integrity, and performance before annotation UI depends on it.
design: Follow Epic 1 of the attached plan; preserve DOM behavior and canvas geometry during the first task.
acceptance_criteria: All direct children close with fresh verification, desktop/narrow evidence, performance comparison, unchanged source manifests, and user visual acceptance.

title: Integrate and validate the revised Focus review workflow
description:
## Why
The event controls, timeline, trajectory, and loading behavior must work together across synthetic edge cases and real read-only MOT20 review before the epic can be accepted.

## What
Exercise each event family, every pair, and all three; cover thresholds, races, gaps, no-event states, past/full trajectory, timeline seeking, delayed loading, new-control axe scans, console/network state, desktop/narrow screenshots, source-integrity manifests, pointer-latency and browser-performance comparison, operator documentation, and final user visual acceptance. Keep real MOT20 track/frame results observational and deterministic gates synthetic.
design: Implement Task 5 of the attached plan only after Tasks 1-4. Use synthetic gapped/sparse/dense fixtures for correctness and MOT20-01 track 72 only as read-only usability evidence. Update README/HANDOFF and performance evidence when measurements change.
acceptance_criteria: Focused and aggregate viewer gates pass; real and synthetic browser journeys pass without console/network/layout failures; new controls have zero serious/critical axe violations; pointer latency remains within the accepted budget; configured source manifests are unchanged; screenshots document stable geometry; and user acceptance is recorded before closing the epic.
notes: Implementation and automated verification complete on 2026-09-03. make acceptance passed; make e2e-real passed 7 with 1 intentional narrow performance skip; source manifests are byte-identical across 2,249 configured files; all pointer p95 runs were 16.8 ms under the 50 ms budget; desktop and narrow screenshots are in track-viz/artifacts/verification/focus-review/. Task remains open solely for required user visual acceptance.

title: Eliminate Focus playback and loading layout shifts
description:
## Why
Transient playback and review-loading messages can enter normal flow, causing the timeline, filmstrip, and lower panels to jump vertically while the reviewer watches a track. Event-refresh mount invariance is handled earlier by mot-06v.1; this issue owns playback image, observation, per-frame Context, and cross-panel geometry.

## Steps to Reproduce
Enter Focus or Context review, start playback, and observe the lower review panels while image decoding, frame observations, or per-frame Context evidence are delayed or fail. Loading states appear and disappear, moving the lower UI.

## What
Add delayed-success and delayed-failure characterization for playback-owned states, move transient statuses into overlays or fixed reserved slots, retain accessible announcements, keep one integration assertion for the Task 1 event-refresh slot, and assert stable Focus, viewport, timeline, filmstrip, and lower-panel geometry at desktop and narrow widths.
design: Implement Task 4 of the attached plan after final history controls exist. Loading feedback must not intercept controls or add normal-flow height. Task 1 owns event-refresh mount/status behavior; this issue owns image decode, observations, Context playback, and cross-panel bounding boxes.
acceptance_criteria: During Focus/Context playback with injected delays or failures, timeline and filmstrip positions vary by at most one CSS pixel; lower controls do not jump; status remains accessible; and controls stay operable unless their own action is genuinely unavailable.
close_reason: Verified overlay-based loading/error states with no normal-flow shift: 67/67 frontend tests, TypeScript, 14/14 focused desktop+narrow geometry cases, and full deterministic E2E 40 passed with 10 expected local-data skips. Image, observation, Context, and event refresh success/failure states kept Focus, viewport, timeline, filmstrip, and source-status within 1 CSS px and controls remained operable.

title: Build temporal and spatial track-history visualization
description:
## Why
The current timeline shows only endpoint, gap-start, and enabled-event markers, so continuous tracks appear as two dots and the reviewer cannot see intermediate occupancy or current progress. The short existing trace also does not offer an explicit complete-track view.

## What
Build a sequence-wide interactive history rail with occupied runs, explicit gaps, current playhead, collision-safe activity markers, pointer/keyboard seeking, and a complementary gap-aware trajectory that defaults to past-through-current and can explicitly show the complete track with future evidence distinguished.
design: Implement Task 3 of the attached plan. Use failing pure plan tests first. Preserve exact one-based seeking; implement one range-style rail control with Arrow=1 frame, Shift+Arrow=10, and Home/End bounds; render at most 256 deterministically aggregated evidence glyphs; never connect trajectory segments across gaps; cap trajectory vertices at 512 while preserving required evidence; keep static evidence under reduced-motion preferences.
acceptance_criteria: Continuous and gapped tracks visibly expose intermediate evidence and current position; range-style timeline seeking is exact and accessible; activity glyph density stays within budget and overlapping evidence remains usable; past mode contains no future evidence; complete mode is distinct; trajectory gaps remain disconnected on desktop and narrow layouts.
close_reason: Verified sequence-wide accessible rail and gap-aware trajectory: 67/67 frontend tests and TypeScript passed; full deterministic Playwright passed 28 with 10 expected local-data skips. Covers exact pointer/keyboard seeking, singleton and continuous runs, current playhead, bounded accessible evidence summary and 256-glyph aggregation, past/complete modes, future styling, reduced-motion retention, gap breaks, and <=512-vertex fallback preserving first/last/current.

title: Make review-event navigation activity-aware
description:
## Why
The current Previous/Next enabled-event controls merge displacement, scale, proximity, and meaningful confidence into one unexplained frame list. Dense proximity or accidental zero displacement/scale thresholds can therefore look like ordinary one-frame stepping.

## What
Characterize all three raw detectors without changing the backend API, derive deterministic frontend activity episodes, remove the combined navigator, add persistent family-specific counts and Previous/Next controls with diagnostic reasons, keep low-confidence navigation per-frame and separate, expose raw/activity counts, and use family-aware density warnings. Sentinel-only sources expose no track-event controls.
design: Implement Task 2 of the attached plan. Production events.py is inspect-only unless characterization proves a separately approved backend defect. Episodes never merge across missing observations. Displacement/scale anchor at greatest severity with earliest-frame ties; proximity groups by typed usable competitor ID and anchors at closest approach. Raw events remain auditable.
acceptance_criteria: On a deterministic synthetic fixture, displacement at 0.02 seeks the fixture-derived activity anchor rather than the next ordinary frame, with raw-next and grouped-anchor behavior asserted separately; default scale reports no target with a reason; continuous per-competitor proximity is one understandable activity; low confidence stays per-frame and separate; every unavailable action remains visibly and accessibly disabled.
close_reason: Verified frontend-derived activity episodes with unchanged backend contract: 59/59 frontend tests, 5/5 backend event characterizations, TypeScript, and 6 desktop/narrow Playwright cases passed. Covers gap isolation, deterministic severity ties, per-competitor proximity, separate low-confidence navigation, family-specific counts/actions, all disabled reasons, density warnings, and raw-next versus grouped-anchor behavior.

title: Stabilize Focus event settings and refresh lifecycle
description:
## Why
Typing decimal thresholds currently causes per-keystroke Focus reloads; a requested 0.02 can become 0, controls disappear, and unrelated track evidence is fetched again.

## Steps to Reproduce
Open a tracked source in Focus, enable abrupt displacement, select the threshold, and type 0.02 character by character. The Focus panel reloads after the first character, the applied threshold becomes 0, and Next enabled event can seek the next ordinary frame.

## What
Characterize the failure with a deterministic synthetic fixture, separate event refreshes from track/filmstrip loading, keep Focus content mounted, add validated draft threshold state with 300 ms debounce plus immediate Enter/blur commit, cancel stale requests, and retain the last successful state on refresh failure. This issue owns event-refresh mount invariance and its fixed status slot; playback image, observation, and per-frame Context geometry belongs to mot-06v.4.
design: Implement Task 1 of the attached plan. Invalid drafts issue no request and revert on blur with an accessible reason. Failed refreshes retain prior valid data/settings and use a non-layout-shifting retry state.
acceptance_criteria: Character-by-character entry of 0.02 remains 0.02; the existing combined next-event action seeks the exact frame derived by the synthetic characterization fixture rather than the next ordinary frame; all checkbox combinations persist; only event data refreshes; timeline and filmstrip remain mounted during success and failure.
close_reason: Verified stable event-only refresh lifecycle: frontend suite 54/54 passed, TypeScript passed, and delayed-event tracer passed in desktop and narrow Chromium; 0.02 draft, stale-response protection, checkbox composition, mounted Focus evidence, failure retry, and no evidence/filmstrip refetch are covered.

title: Improve Focus track history and event review
description:
## Why
Focus review currently hides intermediate track history, can turn typed decimal event thresholds into zero, merges different event families into an opaque navigation stream, and allows transient loading states to move the lower review UI.

## What
Execute the approved five-child plan for stable event settings, family-specific activity navigation, temporal and spatial track history, layout-stable playback/loading feedback, and final browser acceptance. Source files remain read-only; source-path display and the Explore-mode B shortcut do not change.
design: Follow the attached approved plan. Preserve exact one-based frame, source-row, source-hash, and sequence-local track identity. Raw events remain auditable while the frontend derives deterministic activity episodes.
acceptance_criteria: All five child issues close with fresh focused and aggregate verification; timeline and trajectory behavior is accepted in the browser; event controls retain correct settings and navigate explicit families; playback produces no material lower-panel layout shift; source manifests remain unchanged.

title: Accept effective same-origin source selection
description:
## Why
Source selection compares Origin only to the startup URL, so a page served through an equivalent host alias such as localhost:8000 is rejected with invalid_source_selection_origin.

## What
Validate source-selection POSTs against the request's effective origin while retaining the configured development origin and rejecting cross-origin callers.
acceptance_criteria: Source selection succeeds when Origin matches the URL serving the request, including localhost aliases; configured dev-origin remains supported; missing and attacker origins remain rejected; focused API and browser checks pass.
close_reason: Changed source selection origin validation to accept the effective trusted request origin as well as configured dev origin. Verified localhost:8000 alias loads attached MOT20-06 tracks (1008 frames, 137328 rows), frame 1 returns 200, real UI renders frame 1 with no origin error, attacker and missing origins remain 403, 11 API tests and 63 full backend tests pass, Ruff and mypy pass.

title: Improve server path browsing and smooth viewer playback
description:
## Why
Long native datalist suggestions clip server paths and empty browsing starts inside the repository. Playback advances on a fixed timer even when the current frame bitmap has not decoded.

## What
Expose navigable server filesystem entries with full-path presentation, and gate playback on completed frame draws while prefetching a bounded forward batch.
acceptance_criteria: Users can navigate from the server filesystem root, move to parent directories, and see full untrimmed paths; direct text entry remains supported. Playback never advances before the current frame is rendered, uses bounded batched prefetch, and focused backend/frontend/browser checks pass.
close_reason: Added server-root filesystem browsing with parent/child navigation and full wrapping paths; added readiness-gated playback, 12-frame forward batches, three prefetch workers, and in-flight decode deduplication. Verified 63 backend, 49 frontend, 4 CVAT, 22 deterministic E2E, 5 real E2E (1 expected skip), delayed-frame desktop/narrow journeys, unchanged source manifests, bounded 150-bitmap real scrub, lint/type/build/smoke/pip gates, and live port 8000 health.

title: Add server-path source selection UI
description:
## Why
The viewer page currently exposes only the source loaded at startup, but users need to enter image-directory and prediction/ground-truth paths from the server filesystem.

## What
Add an atomic same-origin source-selection API, bounded server-filesystem path suggestions, and a two-field React setup form that refreshes the active source without uploading browser-local files.
acceptance_criteria: The page shows image-folder and prediction/GT path fields prefilled from server state; suggestions refer to server paths; applying valid paths replaces the active registry and renders frames; invalid paths preserve the prior source and return a clear error; browser and backend tests pass.
close_reason: Implemented same-origin server-path selection, bounded server suggestions, empty startup, and atomic registry replacement. Verified 63 backend, 46 frontend, 4 CVAT, 20 deterministic E2E, 5 real E2E (1 expected skip), lint/type/build/smoke/pip gates, unchanged source manifests, and live port 18012 fields/suggestions.

title: Accept viewer source paths at launch
description:
## Why
Viewer users need to select an image directory and prediction or ground-truth file without editing a committed source catalog.

## What
Require explicit image and annotation paths for normal launch, infer MOT metadata and row format, preserve an explicit catalog option only for multi-source acceptance, and document the invocation.
acceptance_criteria: Normal launch takes an image folder and annotation file; 9-column ground truth and 10-column predictions load from absolute or repository-relative paths; no implicit catalog fallback remains; full acceptance and real browser suites pass.
close_reason: Implemented explicit --images and --annotations launch inputs with seqinfo and 9/10-column adapter inference; real MOT20-01 ground truth and MOT20-06 predictions loaded successfully on isolated ports; make acceptance passed 59 backend, 44 frontend, 4 CVAT, and 18 deterministic E2E checks; make e2e-real passed 5 active journeys; source manifests remained identical.

title: Harden performance, documentation, and browser acceptance
description:
## Why
Release readiness requires measured dense-frame latency, accessibility, source-integrity evidence, complete operator docs, and human browser acceptance.

## What
Execute Task 8: defined three-run pointer p95 measurement, seek/cache/memory observations, full Playwright journeys and accessibility scans, authoritative docs/index updates, aggregate root commands, source hash audit, and final orchestrator/user browser loop. No new product features.
design: Follow Task 8 and stop after two failed optimization iterations rather than redefining the metric. Document fixture-only tracked limitations until corrected exports exist.
acceptance_criteria: Pointer p95 is below 50 ms in every defined run or an explicit user decision resolves the gate; automated suites and CVAT regression pass; source SHA-256 values are unchanged; no accepted console/network/layout/a11y defects remain; user visual acceptance is recorded.
close_reason: Verified make acceptance and make e2e-real; 57 backend, 44 frontend, 4 CVAT, 18 deterministic E2E and 5 real E2E checks passed; three pointer p95 runs were 16.7-16.8 ms; 2,249 configured source files were SHA-256 identical; desktop, 829px, and 390px browser inspection accepted Explore, Focus, Context, and dense five-candidate states.

title: Deliver focus mode and track navigation
description:
## Why
A confirmed tracked candidate must become a stable, quiet temporal-review workflow across observations and gaps.

## What
Execute Task 5 in the frontend: focus overlay/trace, gap evidence, timeline, bounded filmstrip, tracked chooser crops, ID search, previous/next observation/gap/enabled-event navigation, and stale-response isolation. Backend algorithms and context/export work are forbidden.
design: Follow Task 5. All state is namespaced by source and hash; every marker/action seeks the exact one-based JPEG frame.
acceptance_criteria: A MOT20-01 identity remains correct across observations/gaps; earlier/current/later evidence and enabled-event navigation work; switching to 06/08 leaks no selection; focused tests/E2E and observed browser review pass.
close_reason: Accepted after fresh verification: 38 frontend tests, strict TypeScript/build, and 12 synthetic desktop/narrow Playwright flows passed for focus, temporal crops, exact navigation, gaps, stale-response isolation and source reset; real MOT20-01 continuous track smoke passed in worker run; diagnostics/diff clean.

title: Complete detection-only explore and selection
description:
## Why
Current MOT20-06/08 joco_v1 results can validate dense ambiguity handling but cannot support persistent tracks.

## What
Execute Task 3 entirely in the frontend: quiet Explore canvas, hover/hysteresis/cycling, magnifier, pin-confirm chooser, keyboard navigation, frame controls, directional prefetch, and bounded bitmap LRU. Backend edits and inferred identities are forbidden.
design: Follow Task 3 and the two-stage selection state machine. Detection-only cards show current crops only; every overlapping candidate remains reachable and track actions remain explicitly disabled.
acceptance_criteria: Off-pointer Explore overlay is pixel-empty; dense 06/08 ambiguous selection is deterministic and keyboard accessible; all candidates beyond the five-card viewport remain reachable; Stage 0 unit/E2E and browser checks pass.
close_reason: Accepted after consolidated verification: 21 frontend tests, strict TypeScript/build, and 6 desktop/narrow Playwright flows passed, including overlap cycling, pin/confirm, disabled Follow, empty/no-hit/edge/resize/keyboard states; diagnostics and diff check clean.

title: Build track evidence, filmstrip, and safe crops
description:
## Why
Tracked review needs sequence-scoped observations, deterministic colors, bounded temporal samples, and safe derived crops.

## What
Execute Task 4a: track evidence APIs, color golden vectors, pinned Supervision/Pillow adapter, documented 64-crop sampling, hash-keyed atomic crop cache, and non-blocking image processing. Frontend, context/event algorithms, and exports are forbidden.
design: Follow Task 4a. Raw coordinates remain metadata; only crop pixels clamp. Derived writes stay under artifacts/viewer and sentinel-only sources return typed capability errors.
acceptance_criteria: MOT20-01 continuous/gapped tracks return exact deterministic evidence; 06/08 track requests are rejected explicitly; cache containment/invalidation/concurrency tests and backend gates pass.
close_reason: Verified Task 4a: 42 integrated backend tests passed, Ruff/mypy and local-data smoke clean, Supervision/NumPy/Pillow environment valid, track/color/filmstrip/crop APIs registered, sentinel sources reject typed 409, crop cache safety/concurrency/nonblocking checks pass; independent review found no blockers. Real MOT20-01 has no internal gaps, so gap smoke evidence is synthetic.

title: Establish viewer tooling and strict data contracts
description:
## Why
Every viewer slice depends on reproducible tooling and exact normalization of both local MOT formats.

## What
Execute Task 1 of the approved plan: packaging, stable root commands, enumerated configuration, immutable adapters/indexes, generated-path ignores, synthetic tests, and read-only local smoke coverage. Datasets, CVAT, frontend, and exports are forbidden.
design: Follow Task 1 of the approved plan. Preserve raw rows and boxes, index only usable positive IDs, and exclude third-party/CVAT/dataset/frontend/artifact trees from ordinary Python discovery.
acceptance_criteria: MOT20-01 reports tracked capability; current MOT20-06/08 joco_v1 report detection-only capability without invented IDs; raw and clamped geometry are preserved; focused test/lint and CVAT regressions pass.
close_reason: Verified Task 1: 15 focused backend tests passed (1 local-data test deselected), Ruff and mypy clean, local MOT20 smoke passed with MOT20-01 tracked and 06/08 sentinel-only, 4 CVAT regressions passed, duplicate-row identity covered, and git diff whitespace check clean.

title: Build read-only frame and metadata API
description:
## Why
The browser needs exact frame bytes and final Stage 0 metadata through a constrained local-only boundary.

## What
Execute Task 2a: health/source/frame/observation API, immutable cache semantics, typed diagnostics, loopback/Host/CORS controls, non-blocking file reads, and fixed web/dist mounting. Frontend and track evidence are forbidden.
design: Follow Task 2a. Routes accept only startup-enumerated source/frame identities and expose hashes, provenance, capability, and MOTPolicy classification without client paths.
acceptance_criteria: Exact first/middle/last frame bytes and metadata are correct; ETag behavior passes; loopback/Host/CORS and delayed-read concurrency tests pass; local curl smoke succeeds.
close_reason: Verified Task 2a: 27 backend tests passed, Ruff/mypy clean, local-source smoke passed, independent requirements review found no blockers, live loopback server served MOT20-01 frames 1/215/429 byte-identically, strong GET ETag returned 304, untrusted Host returned 400, and production CORS emitted no allow-origin header; server stopped cleanly.

title: Deliver exact-frame browser tracer bullet
description:
## Why
A thin end-to-end tracer must prove the new frontend toolchain, API path, and frame geometry before interaction work expands.

## What
Execute Task 2b: React/TypeScript/Vite/Vitest/Playwright bootstrap, viewer shell, source/frame controls, policy/provenance states, stacked canvas, and shared letterbox transform. Return BLOCKED if Node or authorized browser installation is unavailable.
design: Follow Task 2b. The browser owns interactive rendering; the lower canvas draws JPEG pixels and the upper canvas is reserved for overlays.
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic and MOT20-01 exact frames render nonblank and unstretched at desktop/narrow viewports; inverse transform and one-based seeking pass; test-source labeling is persistent; frontend tests/build/tracer E2E pass.
close_reason: Verified Task 2b: 8 Vitest tests and strict TypeScript passed, Vite production build passed, 2 Playwright desktop/narrow tracer journeys passed with exact first/middle/last frames, canvas pixel/letterbox/empty-overlay and network/console checks; integrated backend remained green and independent review found no blockers.

title: Build dense MOT20 web track viewer
description:
## Why
Dense MOT20 output needs a quiet, deliberate browser review workflow that preserves frame, sequence, track, and source identity.

## What
Implement the approved FastAPI and React viewer plan through ten dependency-scoped child issues. Source images and result files remain read-only.
design: The authoritative implementation specification is docs/plans/2026-09-02-web-track-visualization.md. Work proceeds through its reviewed hybrid dependency graph and bounded Implementer packets.
acceptance_criteria: All ten child issues are complete with fresh task-level evidence; the final browser workflow is observed on detection-only MOT20-06/08 and tracked MOT20-01; source hashes are unchanged; and final user visual acceptance is recorded.
close_reason: Verified make acceptance and make e2e-real; 57 backend, 44 frontend, 4 CVAT, 18 deterministic E2E and 5 real E2E checks passed; three pointer p95 runs were 16.7-16.8 ms; 2,249 configured source files were SHA-256 identical; desktop, 829px, and 390px browser inspection accepted Explore, Focus, Context, and dense five-candidate states.

title: Adopt cross-agent harness and Beads
description: Create the MOT20 repository guidance, project overlay, reusable skills, tool-specific hooks, and Beads policy from the approved harness assessment.
close_reason: Adopted MOT20-specific AGENTS and project overlay; installed 12 validated mirrored skills; wired Claude, Codex, Copilot, and Beads hooks; JSON/TOML/shell parsing, hook behavior, ignore rules, skill parity, leakage checks, and Beads health passed.

title: Package session recovery as an explicit Codex skill
description: Replace the root-level Codex handoff utility with a repository skill under .agents/skills/codex-session-recovery. The skill must be explicit user invocation only, keep scripts and tests inside its folder, show 3-5 recent session candidates with two message excerpts each, ask the user to choose, and load context only after selection. Maintain the repository's .claude skill mirror. Acceptance: skill metadata validates, selection is never automatic, synthetic tests cover candidate previews and bounded extraction, real-session smoke succeeds, and root-level temporary recovery files are removed.
notes: Implemented explicit-only $codex-session-recovery skill under .agents/skills with the repository-required .claude mirror. The picker skips the newest/current transcript, shows up to five matching sessions with two user/assistant tail messages, and requires a second explicit $codex-session-recovery invocation before bounded extraction. Root CODEX_HANDOFF.md and the root script/test were removed. Verification: 2 synthetic unit tests pass; quick_validate reports Skill is valid; real local smoke found 5 candidates/10 previews and extracted 2 messages from session prefix 01a068a7; skill mirrors match.
close_reason: Explicit-only session recovery skill implemented and verified.

title: Add read-only Codex session context recovery
description: Provide a safe repository utility and concise handoff instructions that let a fresh VS Code Codex chat list local sessions for the current repository and load the last selected user/assistant messages without forking a corrupted thread. Acceptance: session selection is explicit, output excludes tool/system payloads, synthetic tests cover listing and tail extraction, and usage is documented in CODEX_HANDOFF.md.
notes: Diagnosis: Bash and the viewer are healthy in a fresh VS Code chat. Broken parent 01a068a7-c0cd-7723-8876-95945abcdd5e had danger-full-access but lost its command tool after compaction/resume. Fork 01a06b99-74e4-7951-ae0c-3fc4619c30a3 also had danger-full-access yet no command tool; the VS Code Codex log recorded 70 dropped exec items for unknown turn 01a068de at fork time. Implemented scripts/codex_session_context.py plus synthetic tests and documented fresh-chat recovery in CODEX_HANDOFF.md. The helper lists top-level interactive sessions for the current cwd and extracts only selected user/assistant tails.
close_reason: Verified with 4 passing synthetic unittest cases, successful extraction from real VS Code session 01a068a7, clean whitespace checks, and git diff --check.

title: Swap track assignments across an interval
description:
## Why
Paired identity switches require an atomic interval operation rather than many fragile row edits.

## What
Implement two-track interval swap with one-sided presence, gaps, collisions, preview, commit, undo, provenance, and export.
design: Use exact inclusive interval semantics and the shared revision infrastructure.
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover both-present and one-sided frames, gaps, interval edges, collisions, changed references, undo, composition, export, and source integrity.

title: Integrate and validate track identity correction
description:
## Why
Individually correct operations can still conflict when composed across one corrected result.

## What
Run composed add/remove/split/merge/swap cases, recovery, accessibility, performance, corrected-export round trips, and source integrity.
design: Use deterministic identity corruption fixtures and ground-truth-backed diagnostics without automatic correction.
acceptance_criteria: All release gates and composition cases pass; corrected exports round-trip; performance is measured; source manifests remain equal; user acceptance is recorded.

title: Split tracks
description:
## Why
Identity switches and mixed tracks require exact, reviewable split operations.

## What
Implement interval-boundary splitting with preview, gaps, collisions, atomic commit, undo, provenance, and export.
design: Use approved identity semantics and deterministic corruption fixtures.
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover boundaries, gaps, changed references, collisions, undo, composition, export, and source integrity.

title: Merge track fragments
description:
## Why
Fragmented identities require deliberate merging without conflating ambiguous overlaps or duplicates silently.

## What
Implement fragment selection, overlap/duplicate handling, destination identity, atomic commit, undo, provenance, and export.
design: Core merge is manual and deterministic; ranking assistance is deferred.
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover disjoint fragments, overlaps, duplicates, collisions, destination IDs, undo, composition, export, and source integrity.

title: Add and remove observations
description:
## Why
Reviewers need explicit creation and removal after field defaults and generated identities are defined.

## What
Implement observation add/remove with revision, undo, provenance, validation, and corrected export.
design: Reuse the approved ledger and effective-state infrastructure.
acceptance_criteria: Tests prove valid add/remove, defaults, generated identity, conflicts, undo, effective reads, export, and source immutability.

title: Define observation and identity operation semantics
description:
## Why
Generated observations and multi-track operations need exact identities, intervals, collisions, composition, and export mapping before implementation.

## What
Approve generated IDs, added-row defaults, track-ID allocation, interval boundaries, gaps, overlaps, collisions, operation ordering, and changed-reference behavior.
design: Use synthetic and MOT contract examples; do not implement until semantics are reviewed.
acceptance_criteria: A reviewed specification resolves every identity and field default, collision case, operation composition rule, undo behavior, and export mapping.

title: Add Track-Viz track identity corrections
description:
## Why
Track cleaning requires explicit observation, split, merge, and interval-swap operations after the box-correction infrastructure is proven.

## What
Define identity operation semantics, implement add/remove, split, merge, and swap, then validate correction composition and export.
design: Follow Epic 4 of the attached plan; keep ranking and ReID assistance outside the core identity operations.
acceptance_criteria: All children close with exact interval/collision semantics, atomic revisions, undo, corrected export, accessibility, performance, and source-integrity evidence.

title: Validate the box-correction vertical slice
description:
## Why
The first edit workflow must be proven across correctness, recovery, interaction, export, and performance before identity operations build on it.

## What
Run the full reducer, API, browser, accessibility, performance, export, recovery, and source-integrity matrix.
design: Use deterministic fixtures for behavior and read-only MOT20 data for observational usability evidence.
acceptance_criteria: All release gates pass with edit-drag, commit/undo, large-ledger seek, and export measurements; source manifests are equal; desktop/narrow evidence and user acceptance are recorded.

title: Add pending diff and numeric box adjustment
description:
## Why
Reviewers need exact before/after evidence and non-pointer correction for precise geometry.

## What
Add pending-change inspection, before/after diff, command history, keyboard adjustment, and exact numeric xywh editing.
design: Pending changes remain uncommitted until explicit confirmation and reuse the correction ledger.
acceptance_criteria: Tests prove exact numeric and keyboard edits, diff accuracy, pending/confirmed separation, revision safety, accessibility, and long-list behavior.

title: Materialize corrected MOT results
description:
## Why
Reviewed corrections need a reproducible derived result without overwriting configured sources.

## What
Export corrected MOT rows with deterministic ordering, numeric precision, source/revision provenance, and round-trip validation.
design: Write only to protected derived artifact paths and preserve source-specific opaque fields according to the approved contract.
acceptance_criteria: Round-trip tests reproduce the effective revision, metadata identifies source and revision, ordering/precision are deterministic, and source manifests remain unchanged.

title: Commit existing-box corrections
description:
## Why
Transient geometry must become validated durable corrections without accepting stale or invalid edits.

## What
Connect preview to committed commands with minimum-size, off-frame, raw/display geometry, conflict, cancellation, and optimistic revision behavior.
design: Use test-driven public API and browser coverage; source rows remain immutable.
acceptance_criteria: Tests prove valid commit, invalid rejection, stale conflict, exact geometry, cancellation, revision advance, and unchanged source artifacts.

title: Add undo, redo, and draft recovery
description:
## Why
Annotation work must survive mistakes, restarts, source changes, and interrupted sessions.

## What
Implement command-granular undo/redo, branch-after-undo behavior, durable recovery, source-switch protection, and visible dirty/save state.
design: Use ledger commands and revisions rather than in-place state reversal.
acceptance_criteria: Tests prove undo/redo, redo invalidation after new edits, crash recovery, guarded source switching, and accurate dirty/save status.

title: Add precision zoom and pan
description:
## Why
Fitted 1080p frames are not sufficient for precise bounding-box correction.

## What
Add high-DPI-correct zoom/pan primitives and controls without conflicting with frame seeking, playback, or all-box reveal.
design: Preserve one shared image/overlay transform and stable viewport geometry.
acceptance_criteria: Mouse and keyboard tests prove exact zoom/pan alignment, bounds, reset, high-DPI resizing, shortcut compatibility, and no layout or pointer regression.

title: Add transient existing-box edit rendering
description:
## Why
Continuous edit feedback must remain responsive without committing data or rerendering the React tree on every pointer movement.

## What
Add Review/Edit modes, handles, hit-testing, pointer capture, cancel behavior, and an imperative transient edit layer.
design: Keep preview geometry in refs/canvas state and commit only at explicit interaction boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Tests prove handle selection, drag/resize preview, cancellation, pointer capture, high-DPI alignment, no writes during movement, and measured next-paint latency.

title: Implement the correction ledger and reducer
description:
## Why
Corrections need atomic, recoverable persistence and one authoritative effective-state reducer.

## What
Add the local transactional ledger and reducer with replay, append, revision advance, undo-branch behavior, and crash recovery without source-file mutation.
design: Keep persistence local and bounded; use deterministic reducer tests before API integration.
acceptance_criteria: Tests prove atomic command persistence, deterministic replay, revision advance, branch behavior, recovery, and unchanged source files.

title: Add revision-aware effective read APIs
description:
## Why
Source hashes alone cannot reject stale responses after corrections create multiple effective revisions.

## What
Add revision-aware frame, observation, track, context, and export reads plus stale-write rejection. Make event evidence unavailable for edited drafts until separately integrated.
design: Every affected request and response carries source and effective revision identity.
acceptance_criteria: API and browser tests reject stale revisions, prevent stale response adoption, return effective state consistently, and explain unavailable edited-draft events.

title: Deliver the first Track-Viz box-correction vertical slice
description:
## Why
A safe end-to-end existing-box edit is needed to establish correction semantics, persistence, performance, and UI architecture before identity operations.

## What
Specify revisioned correction state, implement local persistence and effective reads, add zoom/pan and transient editing, commit and recover edits, review diffs, and export corrected MOT results.
design: Follow Epic 3 of the attached plan; immutable sources plus an ordered ledger define the effective revision.
acceptance_criteria: All children close with reducer replay, revision safety, precision edit behavior, undo/recovery, corrected export round-trip, accessibility, performance, and source-integrity evidence.

title: Consolidate viewer under track-viz
description: Move the viewer backend, UI, tests, config, scripts, packaging, and docs into a self-contained track-viz directory while preserving root commands and runtime behavior.
close_reason: Consolidated backend, React UI, tests, config, scripts, docs, and preserved artifacts under track-viz; make acceptance passed (63 backend, 49 frontend, 4 CVAT, 22 deterministic E2E, 1 local smoke), and API/UI runtime checks returned 200.

title: Deliver context mode and review ergonomics
description:
## Why
Reviewers need restrained competition evidence and a fully keyboard/accessibility-capable workflow without restoring dense visual overload.

## What
Execute Task 6 only in the frontend: Focus/Context controls, capped corner markers with hysteresis, optional event controls, listbox/live-region/reduced-motion semantics, and responsive layout. No backend or dependency edits.
design: Follow Task 6. Shape and stroke weight, not color alone, distinguish focal and context tracks. Missing response fields return to the orchestrator.
acceptance_criteria: Draw-plan ink/label/focal-dominance bounds pass at the densest MOT20-01 frame; keyboard and responsive E2E pass; user-observed comparison validates or lowers the default context count.
close_reason: Accepted after post-integration verification: 44 frontend tests, strict TypeScript/build, 16 automated desktop/narrow E2E flows, and worker-run real dense MOT20-01 Focus/Context checks passed; accessibility, hysteresis, draw-plan dominance and responsive behavior covered. Human target-display review remains in final acceptance.

title: Add bounded Supervision exports and render parity
description:
## Why
Bounded clips and offline per-track videos may accelerate review if they preserve the browser identity contract and provenance.

## What
Execute Task 7: synchronous exports capped at 300 frames, offline per-track video, Origin protection, Supervision focal/context rendering, no-overwrite hash-keyed artifacts, provenance sidecars, and representative browser/export parity. No queues or source mutation.
design: Follow Task 7. All outputs are atomic derived artifacts; interactive requests beyond the cap are rejected with offline guidance.
acceptance_criteria: Browser/export colors and geometry agree within approved tolerance; stale/collision/partial-failure tests pass; one short clip and per-track video are structurally checked and observed; existing artifacts remain unchanged.
close_reason: Accepted after post-integration verification: 57 backend tests, Ruff/mypy/pip check/local smoke clean; bounded export safety/parity/provenance tests pass; real 10- and 26-frame MP4V exports decode at 1920x1080/25fps with metadata hashes; derived artifacts preserved.

title: Build context ranking and optional events
description:
## Why
Context and heuristic events require deterministic backend evidence without coupling algorithms to browser state.

## What
Execute Task 4b: bounded temporal competitor ranking, normalized proximity/IoU evidence, optional displacement/scale/interaction events, and meaningful-confidence timeline evidence. Frontend, manifests, crops, exports, and persistence are forbidden.
design: Follow Task 4b. Gap/lifespan evidence is unconditional; heuristic events are disabled by default; GT visibility is never relabeled as tracker confidence.
acceptance_criteria: Same source hash/settings produce identical sequence-local results; caps/ties/thresholds and confidence capability variants are tested; sentinel-only sources reject track evidence; backend gates pass.
close_reason: Accepted after consolidated verification: 48 backend tests passed with context caps/ties/windows, optional event thresholds/default-off behavior, confidence diagnostics and sentinel rejection; Ruff/mypy and diagnostics clean.

title: Create MOT20 CVAT administrator and reviewer accounts
description: Provision the named CVAT users after local credential policy is configured. The administrator password is present locally; reviewer passwords remain unspecified.
close_reason: Created the admin plus 11 named reviewer accounts. Verified each reviewer can authenticate to the healthy local CVAT API; generated distinct temporary passwords in owner-readable ignored local files.

title: Restore MOT20 CVAT browser health endpoint
description: Diagnose the port-8082 browser failure, retire the separate legacy CVAT port-8081 stack without deleting volumes, and restore CVAT health endpoint behavior while preserving the MOT20 stack and source mount.
close_reason: Verified UI/API reachability and 200 health payload; stopped legacy CVAT containers on port 8081 with volumes preserved; only port 8082 remains listening.

title: Provision MOT20 CVAT automation workspace
description: Create a repo-local, reproducible CVAT stack and idempotent workflow to seed MOT20 test image tasks and assign jobs from reviewed configuration. Preserve source frame identity and avoid dataset mutation.
close_reason: Verified isolated CVAT stack at http://127.0.0.1:8082; tested contract validation, deterministic 4,479-frame dry run, read-only image mount, compose rendering, API and UI reachability.

title: Validate assisted correction review
description:
## Why
Proposal usefulness depends on measured quality, workload, performance, and safe integration rather than visual polish alone.

## What
Measure proposal quality and reviewer workload plus large-list performance, revision safety, accessibility, export provenance, and source integrity.
design: Use documented diagnostic and held-out distinctions; never fabricate quality claims.
acceptance_criteria: Evaluation and release evidence document quality, workload, performance, revision behavior, provenance, accessibility, and unchanged sources.

title: Implement bounded correction-proposal generation
description:
## Why
Approved evidence should produce revision-aware candidates without blocking interaction or changing tracks.

## What
Generate bounded, cached, revision-aware suggestions without applying corrections.
design: Requires established ReID output and completed event and identity foundations.
acceptance_criteria: Tests prove bounded generation, revision staleness, provenance, cancellation, deterministic ordering, and no automatic correction.

title: Add proposal review and decision capture
description:
## Why
Suggestions require explicit human accept, reject, or uncertain outcomes with auditable reasons.

## What
Present evidence and capture reviewer decisions with source, revision, model, threshold, reason, and timestamp provenance.
design: Reuse correction operations only after explicit acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Browser and API tests prove all decision outcomes, provenance, revision safety, accessibility, and no silent application.

title: Add assisted Track-Viz correction proposals
description:
## Why
ReID and event evidence may later reduce reviewer workload, but no established ReID implementation or proposal-quality contract exists yet.

## What
After prerequisites exist, define and evaluate proposal inputs, generate bounded revision-aware suggestions, capture decisions, and validate quality and workload.
design: Deferred Epic 5 only; proposals never apply corrections silently.
acceptance_criteria: All children close with evaluated proposal quality, complete model/source/revision provenance, reviewer decisions, accessibility, performance, and source integrity.

title: Define assisted-proposal inputs and evaluation
description:
## Why
Proposal generation is unsafe without established ReID/event inputs, provenance, quality metrics, thresholds, and uncertainty policy.

## What
Define candidate inputs, model/checkpoint provenance, diagnostic evaluation, ranking, thresholds, uncertainty, and workload success criteria.
design: Remain deferred until an established ReID workstream output exists.
acceptance_criteria: A reviewed specification defines inputs, evaluation protocol, quality thresholds, uncertainty, provenance, and non-goals.
